packageRules.description: sqlx must stay on the minor mairie360_api_lib uses (DbError::Sqlx is matched across the two crates): bump it together with the lib.

tracing-actix-web propagates the incoming traceparent through its own OpenTelemetry version (feature opentelemetry_0_x, 0.32 at most in 0.7.25): keep opentelemetry* on that version and tracing-opentelemetry on its paired release, and bump them together with the tracing-actix-web feature once it supports the next one.
The reusable workflow is referenced twice in cicd.yml (`uses:` pinned by commit, and the `cicd_version` input): bump both in one PR (MAIR-427).
